subject: Security awareness training — complete by Oct 31
body_html:
Hi,

As part of our annual security compliance programme, all employees must complete the Security Awareness Training module on our LMS by October 31, 2026. It takes approximately 45 minutes.

Log in at lms.acme.test and search for 'SA-2026'.

Olivia, InfoSec
